event: Atlético Dallas signed Javier 'Chicharito' Hernández, Mexico's all-time leading scorer, to a two-year contract with a club option for a third season as the expansion club's first-ever player ahead of their 2027 USL Championship debut.

Atlético Dallas confirmed Cotton Bowl as inaugural home venue and positioned the Chicharito signing explicitly in the context of USL Premier-level ambition, signaling aggressive pre-launch investment ahead of 2027 entry.

Vermont Green FC defeated Flint City Bucks 2–1 in the 2026 USL League Two Final to win back-to-back national championships, becoming the first club to do so since 2003, finishing the season 18W-1D-0L with an unbeaten streak of 42 matches.
Vermont Green FC's women's team reached the USL W League Final in the club's inaugural women's season, underlining organizational depth and community investment across both programs.
Flint City Bucks lost the 2026 USL League Two Final 2–1 at home at Atwood Stadium, ending their bid for a fifth national title and first since 2019.
Tampa Bay Rowdies defeated Miami FC 3–2 to extend their Eastern Conference lead to 35 points, 8 points clear of the next cluster of clubs, with a goal differential of +13 after 17 matches.
Miami FC lost 3–2 at home to Tampa Bay Rowdies, dropping to 8th in the Eastern Conference on 21 points, sitting on a -7 goal differential through 18 matches.
Sacramento Republic FC defeated Oakland Roots SC 3–1, with Kyle Edwards earning USL Championship Player of the Week honors for two goals in the victory.
Oakland Roots SC lost 3–1 to Sacramento Republic FC on the road, continuing a difficult mid-season stretch in the Western Conference.
Rhode Island FC defeated Pittsburgh Riverhounds SC 1–0 to move to 22 points in the Eastern Conference, keeping pace in the playoff race.
Pittsburgh Riverhounds lost 1–0 away at Rhode Island FC, sitting 5th in the Eastern Conference on 23 points with a -1 goal differential through 17 matches.
Pittsburgh Riverhounds owner announced a $125 million stadium expansion project increasing Highmark Stadium capacity from 5,500 to 15,000, explicitly to qualify for USL Premier in 2028.
Sporting Club Jacksonville sits 13th in the Eastern Conference with just 8 points from 18 matches and a -23 goal differential, the worst position in the division through Week 17.
Athletic Club Boise leads USL League One in cumulative attendance at 43,248 with a per-match average of 7,208, recording the highest individual gate of the season (7,227 in a win over Chattanooga).
Fort Wayne FC carry the longest unbeaten run in USL League One at 7 games, a form streak dating back to April 11.
Corpus Christi FC have gone 10 matches without a win from the start of the 2026 League One season, sitting bottom with 5 points and a -11 goal differential through 10 matches.

New York Renegades FC — defending UPSL Fall 2025 champions — entered the UPSL Spring 2026 National Finals semifinals in Los Angeles against Miami United FC, seeking back-to-back national championships.

Miami United FC reached the UPSL Spring 2026 National Finals for the second consecutive season after defeating SCU Heat in a penalty shootout in the Southeast Regional final, earning a semifinal slot against NY Renegades.

Deportivo Rose City (Oregon) made their first UPSL National Finals appearance, entering the Spring 2026 semifinals in Los Angeles against Central Kansas United after winning the Oregon Conference title with an 8W-1D-1L record.
Central Kansas United made their first UPSL National Finals appearance after a strong playoff campaign, reaching the Spring 2026 semifinals in Los Angeles.
San Antonio FC publicly mulling potential USL Premier entry in 2028 while running a free-ticket community promotion tied to post-World Cup fan growth momentum.
Louisville City FC has publicly committed to joining USL Premier at its 2028 launch, one of the first clubs to formally announce intent to enter the new Division One.
